import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")

# Create Body and attach sketch to XY plane
body = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body', 'Body')
xy = body.Origin.OriginFeatures[3]  # XY_Plane

# Create sketch
sk = body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'Sketch')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

# Define rectangle helper
def rect(sk, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    sk.addGeometry([
        Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(x0, y0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(x1, y0, 0)),
        Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(x1, y0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(x1, y1, 0)),
        Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(x1, y1, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(x0, y1, 0)),
        Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(x0, y1, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(x0, y0, 0))
    ], False)
    for i in range(4):
        sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i+1) % 4, 1))
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 0))
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 2))
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 1))
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 3))

# Draw 10x10 square with corner at origin
rect(sk, 0, 0, 10, 10)
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 0, 1, -1, 1))  # first point at origin
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', 0, 1, 0, 2, 10.0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', 1, 1, 1, 2, 10.0))

# Pad
pad = body.newObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'Pad')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 5

# Linear Pattern along sketch H_Axis
lp = body.newObject('PartDesign::LinearPattern', 'Pattern')
lp.Originals = [pad]
lp.Direction = (sk, ['H_Axis'])
lp.Length = 40
lp.Occurrences = 3
body.Tip = lp

doc.recompute()

# Four line segments forming a closed rectangle

p3 = FreeCAD.Vector(10, 10, 0)
p4 = FreeCAD.Vector(0, 10, 0)

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(p4, p1), False)

sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 1, 2, 2, 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 2, 2, 3, 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 3, 2, 0, 1))

sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 3))
